correctness.rationale: Counting cyclic sets, permutations and rooted forests gives q(n,k)=k(n)_k/n^(k+1); conditional F has rencontres law R_k, unconditional Bin(n,1/n). Unit conditional mean proves zero covariance and K=1 proves dependence n>=2. Exact TV disintegration and |TV(R_k,B_n)-TV(B_n,Poi(1))|<=TV(R_k,Poi(1)) combine with nq(n,k)<=k and weighted-summable rencontres error to give limit. Alternating remainder and Tonelli yield sum_k k delta_k=(3e^2+1)/8; first-order binomial-to-Poisson variation yields 3/(4e). Checked independence of last limit and boundaries n=1,2.
